title: I flipped a 50k into a 100k
author: vvs_nq
selftext:
didnt know there was such reddit but i wanted to tell you what is actually possible with ai. i built a terminal with alot of important data as well as ai integration to analyze everything (because tbh im very lazy and im done with all the sitting at charts, waiting for setups, looking at orderflow stuff).   
in the past 3 months i got no red days and a 90% wr which is insane. never believed in ai until now. still trying to improve it every day and i see alot of potential that i havent used but will do soon.

comments.author: ImaToughGuyyy
comments.body: I’m new to all of this, what does that mean “with a lot of important data”?

replies.author: vvs_nq
replies.body: very deep topic. it simply shows you what bias we get, if we range or trend, where magnets are, where real support and resistance is, how much we actually accelerate and much more. it also top ticks most trades which is insane

replies.author: ImaToughGuyyy
replies.body: Interesting, and when you say you “built a terminal” what does that look like? Is that one of those HTML’s that people build kind of like a dashboard? or did you build more of like a website?

replies.author: vvs_nq
replies.body: i got my own website running this

comments.author: onelittledragon
comments.body: Some details about your strategy would be helpful.

replies.body: its my own i wont leak anything
